rename.from: OpenID Connect Realm fails with special characters are present in client id
rename.to: OpenID Connect realm fails when special characters are present in client id

body:
This is a bug according to the specification, as both client id and client password need to be encoded using the `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` encoding algorithm when used for HTTP Basic
   authentication. https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6749#section-2.3.1

issue.title: Fix credential encoding for OIDC token request

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
As defined in https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6749#section-2.3.1
both client id and client secret need to be encoded with the
application/x-www-form-urlencoded encoding algorithm when used as
credentials for HTTP Basic Authentication in requests to the OP.

Resolves #43709
